shared.zh: 读寄存卡：同名寄存卡里存的值，存入之前给初值
shared.en: Register: what the register of the same name holds, its start value before

shared.zh: 存寄存卡：接入的值存进同名寄存卡，下一拍读得出
shared.en: Keep: its input stored in the register of the same name, read from the next tick

shared.zh: 选择：条件为是或 1 给出「是」一路，否则「否」一路
shared.en: Select: its Yes input when the condition is yes or 1, else its No input

shared.zh: 取位：8 位数 n 从最高位数起的第 i 位（i 从 0 起）
shared.en: Bit of: bit i of the 8-bit number n, counted from the top (from 0)

about.en: Constant: the number it is set to
Add: the sum of two numbers

about.zh: 相等：两个数相同时为是
about.en: Equal: yes when two numbers are the same

shared.zh: 每一拍：这根进线这一拍到达的位
shared.en: tick by tick: the bit arriving on the wire this tick

about.zh: 这一关的一根进线的名字
about.en: the name of one of the level’s wires in

shared.zh: 每一拍：这根进线这一拍到达的位的反面
shared.en: tick by tick: the opposite of the bit arriving on the wire this tick

shared.zh: 每一拍：两根进线这一拍的位不同时为 1，相同为 0
shared.en: tick by tick: 1 when the two wires’ bits differ this tick, 0 when they agree

shared.zh: 每一拍：这根进线上一拍的位；第一拍给 first
shared.en: tick by tick: the bit the wire had the tick before; first on the first tick

shared.zh: 每一拍：这根进线上到过 1 了没有（这一拍算在内），到过为 1，否则为 0
shared.en: tick by tick: 1 once a 1 has arrived on the wire (this tick included), 0 before

shared.zh: 每一拍：自从输入 reset 上一次为 1 过了几拍（那一拍为 0；没有过时从第 0 拍数起；输入 hold 为 1 的拍不算）
shared.en: tick by tick: how many ticks since the input `reset` was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from tick 0 before it ever is; ticks the input `hold` is 1 do not count)

about.zh: 这一关的一个输入的名字
about.en: the name of one of the level’s inputs

about.zh: 这一关的一个输入的名字
about.en: the name of one of the level’s inputs

shared.zh: 每一拍：输入 start 第一次为 1 的那一拍起，接连 8 拍说出那一拍输入 byte 的各位（最高位先），其余各拍为 0
shared.en: tick by tick: from the first tick the input `start` is 1, the bits of the input `byte` at that tick over 8 ticks (top bit first), 0 on every other tick

shared.zh: 每一拍：到这一拍为止最后几位正好是 bits 时为 1，否则为 0
shared.en: tick by tick: 1 when the last bits up to this tick are exactly `bits`, else 0

shared.zh: 每一拍：到这一拍为止收到的位（输入 reset 为 1 的那一拍从头算起，输入 hold 为 1 的拍不算）除以生成式的余数，写成一个数；form 为 check 时是这些位后面补上校验位那么多个 0 再除的余数，也就是该跟在它们后面发出的校验位
shared.en: tick by tick: the remainder of the bits received so far (from the last tick the input `reset` is 1, leaving out the ticks the input `hold` is 1) divided by the generator, as a number; with form check, the remainder of those bits followed by as many 0s as there are check bits, which is the check bits to send after them

shared.zh: 每一拍：按格式收到的字节，在它最后一位到达的那一拍（flag 格式在帧尾的旗标结束的那一拍）；其余各拍「—」
shared.en: tick by tick: the bytes received in the format, each on the tick its last bit arrives (in the flag formats, on the tick the closing flag ends); 「—」 on every other tick

shared.zh: 线那头约好的格式（wire.js）：bytes、startstop、parity、check、blocks、flag、flagcheck、flagbyte
shared.en: the format the far end agreed on (wire.js): bytes, startstop, parity, check, blocks, flag, flagcheck, flagbyte

shared.zh: 生成式，最高位在前（默认 1011）
shared.en: the generator, its top bit first (1011 by default)

shared.zh: 每一拍：按格式收到的每个字节（parity、check）或每一帧（flagcheck）是否完好，在它结束的那一拍；其余各拍「—」
shared.en: tick by tick: whether each byte (parity, check) or frame (flagcheck) received in the format is intact, on the tick it ends; 「—」 on every other tick

shared.zh: 每一拍：测试的 expect 里写给这个输出的值（不写的拍不查）
shared.en: tick by tick: the values the test’s `expect` gives this output (ticks left out are not checked)

shared.zh: 不论时机：这个输出给出的不是「—」的值，依次应当是按格式收到的字节（intactOnly：只算完好的帧里的）
shared.en: timing aside: the values this output gives that are not 「—」 must be, in order, the bytes received in the format (intactOnly: only those of intact frames)

shared.zh: 不论时机：这个输出给出的不是「—」的值，依次应当是每一帧结束时它是否完好
shared.en: timing aside: the values this output gives that are not 「—」 must be, in order, whether each frame was intact at its end

shared.zh: 线那头：按格式解出这根出线上说的话，应当正好是测试的队列（帧的格式每帧后面记一个帧尾；坏的不算）
shared.en: the far end: what it decodes in the format from this wire out must be exactly the test’s queue (in the frame formats an end after each frame; nothing broken counts)

shared.zh: 线那头：按格式解出这根出线上说的话，应当是这根进线上到达的每一帧各一个回帧，只装一个字节：完好为 1，坏了为 0
shared.en: the far end: what it decodes in the format from this wire out must be one reply a frame that arrived on the wire in, each holding one byte: 1 when that frame was intact, 0 when broken

shared.zh: 线那头：按格式解出这根出线上说的话，应当正好是这根进线上到达的完好的帧
shared.en: the far end: what it decodes in the format from this wire out must be exactly the intact frames that arrived on the wire in

shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up building, not how many levels

shared.zh: 笔记版：一关对应一个笔记词条，所有关打开，不跑课程审计（手册第 12 节）
shared.en: the notes edition: a level per notes entry, every level open, no course audit (handbook section 12)

shared.zh: 几套托盘：每套是一串元件，按托盘上的先后排；关卡用其中一套，托盘上的元件在带来它或搭出它的那一关之后可用。不写时每关拿到见过的所有元件
shared.en: the trays: each a list of parts in the order it shows them; a level plays with one, and a part on it is usable after the level that brings it in or builds it. Without, every level holds every part it has met

about.zh: 几个元件合起来是一个新概念
about.en: parts that are one new idea together

shared.zh: 能用的显示方式，第一种是起始；只有一种时玩家不能切换
shared.en: the views it may be drawn in, the first to start in; with one, the player cannot switch

shared.zh: 每种形状默认的显示方式（没写的用库里的第一种）
shared.en: the views each shape is drawn in by default (the library’s first where none is given)

shared.zh: 引言或通关文案旁显示的一个值
shared.en: a value shown beside an introduction page or a pass text

about.en: a value shown beside the pass text

shared.zh: 这一关（这个任务）用的托盘；游戏只有一套托盘时不用写
shared.en: the tray this level (task) plays with; a game of one tray need not say

shared.zh: 它取代的搭出的元件：从这一关往后，托盘里给它，不再给那些
shared.en: the built parts it supersedes: from this level on the tray offers it instead of them

shared.zh: 通过后最后一个任务的板成为元件 type：它的口就是那个任务的进线、输入、出线和输出
shared.en: once passed the last task’s board is the part `type`: its ports are that task’s wires in, inputs, wires out and outputs

shared.zh: 新元件第一次出现时只放它一个也算一关：为什么
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only places it: why

shared.zh: 任务的 id：整款游戏里唯一，玩家存下的板跟着它走（只有一个任务的关通常就用关的 id）
shared.en: the task’s id, unique in the game; what a player keeps of it goes by it (a level’s one task usually has the level’s id)

shared.zh: 这个任务的名字，写在任务条上（一关只有一个任务时不显示）
shared.en: the task’s name on the strip of tasks (not shown when the level has one task)

about.zh: 这次升级留下的管线分段名称
about.en: the pipeline stage this upgrade contributes

shared.zh: 这个任务自己的引言：第一次做到它时读（第一个任务的接在这一关的后面）
shared.en: the task’s own intro: read the first time it is played (the first task’s after the level’s)

shared.zh: 这个任务通过时说的话（最后一个任务用这一关的点题）
shared.en: what passing the task says (the last task says the level’s pass text)

shared.zh: 板听的进线、板说的出线；它们和输入输出一样是板的口
shared.en: the wires the board hears and the wires it says on; like inputs and outputs, they are the board’s ports

shared.zh: 这个口的值起初画成哪种显示方式（玩家在详情和结果区里换）
shared.en: the view its value starts in (the player switches it in its detail and results row)

shared.zh: 板从测试的队列里取字节：input 给出队首的字节（取完了是「—」），last 在它是一帧的最后一个字节时为是，输出 next 为 1 或是的那一拍取走它，下一拍出现下一个
shared.en: the board pulls bytes from the test’s queue: `input` shows the byte at its head (「—」 once used up), `last` is yes when it is a frame’s last byte, and the tick the output `next` is 1 or yes takes it, the next showing the tick after

shared.zh: 线那头依次说的：安静几拍、几位、按格式的字节或帧
shared.en: what the far end says, in turn: quiet ticks, bits, bytes or frames in a format

shared.zh: 这些拍到达的位被线翻转（从 0 数）
shared.en: the ticks whose arriving bit the wire flips (from 0)

about.zh: 每根进线上，线那头说什么
about.en: on each wire in, what its far end says
each input’s value tick by tick

shared.zh: 板取用的队列：一列帧，每帧一列字节
shared.en: the queue the board pulls from: frames, each a list of bytes

shared.zh: given 要的值：每个输出每一拍的值，null 是「—」
shared.en: what `given` wants: each output’s value tick by tick, null for 「—」

shared.zh: 跑多少拍（默认：给的东西都到达以后再过两拍）
shared.en: how many ticks it runs (by default two after everything it gives has arrived)

shared.zh: 隐藏测试：每次运行一并检查，通关后公开；只合上可见测试的板过不了它
shared.en: hidden tests: checked with every run and shown once passed; a board that only fits the visible tests fails them

about.zh: 每个输出和出线应当是什么
about.en: what each output and wire out must be

about.zh: 一块板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: 直觉上的错解：看起来能做、其实过不了这个任务的板，必须失败
shared.en: the naive answer: a board that looks right and is not, which must fail

about.zh: 显示哪一项：任务的一个口
about.en: what the row shows: one of the task’s ports

shared.zh: 结果区的几行，按顺序；不写就是领域默认的几行
shared.en: the results area’s rows, in order; without them the domain’s default rows

shared.zh: 这个任务里每种形状的显示方式（换掉游戏默认的那几种）
shared.en: the views each shape is drawn in in this task (in place of the game’s)

shared.zh: 从玩家在这一关通过时的板开始（没通过就用它的参考解），换上这个任务的进线、输入、出线和输出；必须是先修
shared.en: start from the board the player passed this level with (its reference when not passed), its wires, inputs and outputs swapped for this task’s; it must be a prerequisite

shared.zh: 从上一个任务的板开始，换上这个任务的口
shared.en: start from the task before’s board, its ports swapped for this task’s

shared.zh: 依次做的任务，最后一个通过就通过这一关
shared.en: the tasks done in turn; passing the last passes the level
